restoreError.not-a-backup: That file is not an ICCWorship backup.
restoreError.newer-format: That backup was made by a newer ICCWorship. Install the latest version to restore it.
restoreError.newer-schema: That backup was made by a newer ICCWorship. Install the latest version to restore it.
restoreError.damaged-backup: That backup is damaged (a data file in it can’t be read). Nothing was changed.
restoreError.no-space: There isn’t enough free disk space to restore this backup safely (it is unpacked and a safety copy is made first). Nothing was changed. Free up space and try again.
restoreError.not-started: The restore could not start, so nothing was changed. Close other programs that may use the files (OneDrive, antivirus) and try again.
restoreError.restore-failed: The restore could not finish, so your previous data was put back. Close other programs that may use the files (OneDrive, antivirus) and try again.
restoreError.restore-failed-mixed: The restore could not finish and your previous data could not be put back completely. Close OneDrive and antivirus, then restore the safety backup “{{file}}” (in the backups list below).
restoreError.read-only: This data is open read-only because a newer ICCWorship wrote it, so no backup can be restored here. Restore it with the newer version.
restoreError.read-only-unprepared: Your data is open read-only (see the red bar at the bottom), so no backup can be restored now. Do what the bar says and restart ICCWorship, then try again.
restoreError.forbidden: That file can’t be restored from here. Use Restore… to pick it.

recovery.otherCopyDetail: Another copy of ICCWorship (the installed one or a portable one) is already open on this computer. Use that one, or close it before starting this one. If you can't see it, end ICCWorship in Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) or restart the computer.
recovery.resumeBusy: Something else is on screen now, so nothing was changed. Clear it with Esc, then click Put it back again.
recovery.resumeGone: That item is no longer in the plan, so nothing was put back on screen.
recovery.mainError: Something went wrong inside ICCWorship. What is on screen keeps running; it was written to the log (Help → Open logs folder).
recovery.projectorRestarted: The projector window had a problem and was restarted. It shows what is live again.
recovery.projectorSafe: The projector kept failing, so it now shows black. Go on with the next slide or item, then Settings → Screens → 🔄 Restart projector.
recovery.projectorFailed: The projector window keeps failing. Settings → Screens → 🔄 Restart projector. If it happens again, turn on "Turn off graphics acceleration" in Settings → About.
recovery.stageRestarted: The stage window had a problem and was restarted.
recovery.stageFailed: The stage window keeps failing. Close it and open it again from Settings → Screens.
recovery.renderError: The projector could not show this slide, so it shows black. Move to the next slide or item.
recovery.stageRenderError: The stage display could not show this slide. It shows the next slide normally.
recovery.gpuCrashed: The graphics driver stopped responding. If the projector goes black or freezes, turn on "Turn off graphics acceleration" in Settings → About and restart ICCWorship.
recovery.operatorRecovered: ICCWorship restarted this window after a problem. The projector kept showing what was live (a backing track kept playing, and its lyrics keep following the music); an announcement loop that was running has stopped — press Space to continue.
recovery.operatorCrashed: The ICCWorship window crashed again. The projector keeps showing what is live. Reload the window?
recovery.operatorFrozen: The ICCWorship window is not responding.
recovery.operatorFrozenDetail: The projector, the music and the phone remote keep running. Restart the window now, or keep waiting if it was busy with something long.

track.removeVoiceHelp: “Remove the voice” takes out what sits in the center of a stereo recording — usually the lead singer. No AI, works offline; the result depends on the recording.

voice.mono: ⚠ This file is mono (one channel): the voice can't be separated from the music. Use a stereo recording, or a file that already has no singing.
voice.notStereo: ⚠ Both channels of this file are (almost) the same: removing the center would remove nearly everything. Use a real stereo recording.
voice.narrow: This recording has little stereo: the result may be weak.
voice.limits: Works best on studio recordings with the lead voice in the center. Backing vocals, reverb and voices spread left and right stay.
voice.little: ℹ Little was in the center of this recording: the voice may still be heard. Try “More”.
voice.almostAll: ⚠ Nearly everything was in the center of this recording: the track may sound thin. Try “Less”.

track.timingOld: ⚠ This song's recorded timing no longer fits its slides (the song was changed): advance by hand, or record the timing again.

timing.title: Record timing
timing.recordHelp: Play the track and press Space at each slide: then the lyrics follow the music by themselves.
timing.okHelp: Live, the lyrics follow the music.
timing.oldHelp: The song's slides changed since the timing was recorded: record it again.
timing.help: Press ⏺ Start: the track plays from the beginning. Press Space (or → / a clicker) the moment each slide should appear — the first press is slide 1, so an intro has no text. ← / Backspace takes back the last press.
timing.allMarked: All slides have a time. Press Stop.
timing.keys: Space / → / ↓ / PageDown: next slide · ← / ↑ / PageUp / Backspace: take back. These keys don't move the projector while this window is open.
timing.outOfOrder: Each slide must start after the one before it: fix the times marked in red.
timing.saved: ⏱ Timing saved: live, the lyrics follow the music.
timing.followHelp: The lyrics change by themselves with the music. You can still move by hand: the next slide start in the music takes over again.
timing.introHint: 🎵 Intro — first line in {{time}} (Space shows it now)

ready.itemsMissing_one: {{count}} item points to something that was deleted: {{names}}
ready.itemsMissing_other: {{count}} items point to things that were deleted: {{names}}
ready.filesMissing_one: {{count}} item needs a file that isn't on this computer (moved or deleted): {{names}}
ready.filesMissing_other: {{count}} items need files that aren't on this computer (moved or deleted): {{names}}
ready.itemsWarn_one: {{count}} item may not show as expected: {{names}}
ready.itemsWarn_other: {{count}} items may not show as expected: {{names}}
ready.outputClosed: The projector window is closed: nothing will show on the screen.
ready.outputFailed: The projector window stopped after failing again and again (or shows only black, in safe mode): nothing would show on the screen. Restart it.
ready.oneScreen: Only one screen is connected: the projector shows in a small window. Is the projector or TV plugged in?
ready.outputOnMain: The projector is set to show on this computer's own screen.
ready.outputOk: The projector window is open on the second screen ({{count}} screens connected).
ready.soundMissing: The chosen sound output “{{label}}” is not connected: sound would play through the computer's speakers.
ready.soundDefault: Sound plays through the Windows default output.
ready.phoneDown: The phone remote and stage display are not running.
ready.phoneOk_one: Phone remote and stage display are running ({{count}} connected).
ready.phoneOk_other: Phone remote and stage display are running ({{count}} connected).
ready.noBackup: No “Back up now” copy yet. Keep one on a USB stick in case this computer fails (the automatic backups stay on this computer).
ready.oldBackup_one: The last “Back up now” copy is {{count}} day old.
ready.oldBackup_other: The last “Back up now” copy is {{count}} days old.
ready.backupOk: There is a recent “Back up now” copy.
ready.updateReady: ICCWorship {{version}} is downloaded: it installs when you close the app with nothing on screen, never during the service.
ready.actFailed: That didn't work. Try again, or open Settings → Screens.
